Schoeneberger, C., Zhang, J., McMillan, C., Dunn, J.B. and Masanet, E. (2022). Electrification potential of U.S. industrial boilers and assessment of the GHG emissions impact. Advances in Applied Energy 5, 100089. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.adapen.2022.100089

Locators are journal page numbers (PDF page = printed page). A 13-page stock-and-emissions study with almost no technology parameters; the to-get wishes (heat pump COP, temperature limits, capex, steam temperatures by industry) are NOT in the paper: heat pumps are explicitly out of scope and no cost or temperature data are given. Loaded: electric boiler (efficiency 99%, max electrode capacity 335 MMBtu/hr) and the Table 2 conventional boiler efficiencies by fuel as 6 processes (one per fuel, same technology in several contexts). Table 2 sources are refs [34-36]: Walker/Lv/Masanet 2013, Wouter and Van Wortswinkel 2010 (ETSAP I01), Cleaver-Brooks 2020. Efficiency heating-value basis not stated. Everything else (boiler counts, electrification potential TBtu, GHG changes, grid mixes) is other-values. Supporting information (SI) not held.
